analyzed: om sahanau avatu saha nau bhunaktu saha vīryam karavāvahai tejasvinau adhītam astu mā vidviṣāvahai

original: oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ ||
analyzed: om śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ

original: kathaṃ bandhaḥ kathaṃ mokṣaḥ kā vidyā kā'vidyeti | jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiturīyaṃ ca katham | annamayaprāṇamayamanomayavijñānamayānandamayakośāḥ katham | kartā jīvaḥ pañcavargaḥ kṣetrajñaḥ sākṣī kūṭasthaḥ antaryāmī katham | pratyagātmā māyā ceti katham || 1 ||
analyzed: katham bandhaḥ katham mokṣaḥ kā vidyā kā avidyā iti jāgrat svapna suṣupti turīyam ca katham anna maya prāṇa maya manaḥ maya vijñāna maya ānanda maya kośāḥ katham kartā jīvaḥ pañcavargaḥ kṣetrajñaḥ sākṣī kūṭasthaḥ antaryāmī katham pratyagātmā māyā ca iti katham

original: ātmeśvarajīv'nātmanāṃ dehādīnāmātmatvenābhimanyate so'bhimāna ātmano bandhaḥ tannivṛttirmokṣaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: ātma īśvara jīvnā ātmanām deha ādīnām ātmatvena abhimanyate saḥ u bhimānaḥ ātmanaḥ bandhaḥ tad nivṛttiḥ mokṣaḥ

original: yā tadabhimānaṃ kārayati sā avidyā | so'bhimāno yayā nivartate sā vidyā || 3 ||
analyzed: yā tad abhimānam kārayati sā avidyā saḥ abhimānaḥ yayā nivartate sā vidyā

original: mana ādicaturdaśakaraṇaiḥ puṣkalairādityādyanugṛhītaiḥ śabdādīnviṣayānsthūlānyadopalabhate tadātmano jāgaraṇam | tad vāsanāsahitaircaturdaśakaraṇaiḥ śabdādyābhāve'pi vāsanāmayāñchabdādīnyadopalabhate tadātmanaḥ svapnam | caturdaśakaraṇparamādviśeṣavijñānābhāvādyadā śabdādīnnopalabhate tadātmanaḥ suṣuptam |
analyzed: manaḥ ādi caturdaśa karaṇaiḥ puṣkalaiḥ āditya ādi anugṛhītaiḥ śabda ādīn viṣayān sthūlān yadā upalabhate tadā ātmanaḥ jāgaraṇam tat vāsanā sahitaiḥ caturdaśa karaṇaiḥ śabda ādya abhāve pi vāsanā mayān śabda ādīn yadā upalabhate tadā ātmanaḥ svapnam caturdaśa karaṇ paramāt viśeṣa vijñāna abhāvāt yadā śabda ādīn na upalabhate tadā ātmanaḥ suṣuptam

original: avasthātrayabhāvābhāvasākṣī svayambhāvarahitaṃ nairantaryaṃ caitanyaṃ yadā tadā turīyaṃ caitanyamityucyate || 4 ||
analyzed: avasthā traya bhāva abhāva sākṣī svayambhāva rahitam nairantaryam caitanyam yadā tadā turīyam caitanyam iti ucyate

original: annakāryāṇāṃ kośānāṃ samūho'nnamayaḥ kośa ityucyate | prāṇādi caturdaśavāyubhedā annamayakośe yadā vartante tadā prāṇamayaḥ kośa ityucyate | etatkośadvayasaṃsaktaṃ manādicaturdaśakaraṇairātmā śabdādiviṣayasaṅkalpādīndharmānyadā karoti tadā manomayaḥ kośa ityucyate |
analyzed: anna kāryāṇām kośānām samūha unna mayaḥ kośaḥ iti ucyate prāṇa ādi caturdaśa vāyu bhedāḥ anna maya kośe yadā vartante tadā prāṇa mayaḥ kośaḥ iti ucyate etad kośa dvaya saṃsaktam mana ādi caturdaśa karaṇaiḥ ātmā śabda ādi viṣaya saṅkalpa ādīn dharmān yadā karoti tadā manaḥ mayaḥ kośaḥ iti ucyate

original: etatkośatrayasaṃsaktaṃ tadgataviśeṣajño yadā bhāsate tadā vijñānamayaḥ kośa ityucyate | etatkośacatuṣṭayasaṃsaktaṃ svakāraṇājñāne vaṭakaṇikāyāmiva vṛkṣo yadā vartate tadānandamayaḥ kośa ityucyate || 5 ||
analyzed: etat kośa traya saṃsaktam tad gata viśeṣa jñaḥ yadā bhāsate tadā vijñāna mayaḥ kośaḥ iti ucyate etat kośa catuṣṭaya saṃsaktam sva kāraṇa ajñāne vaṭa kaṇikāyām iva vṛkṣaḥ yadā vartate tadā ānanda mayaḥ kośaḥ iti ucyate

original: sukhaduḥkhabuddhyā śreyo'ntaḥ kartā yadā tadā iṣṭaviṣaye buddhiḥ sukhabuddhiraniṣṭaviṣaye buddhirduḥkhabuddhiḥ | śabdasparśarūparasagandhāḥ sukhaduḥkhahetavaḥ | puṇyapāpakarmānusārī bhūtvā prāptaśarīrasaṃyogamaprāptaśarīrasaṃyogamiva kurvāṇo yadā dṛśyate tadopahitajīva ityucyate || 6 ||
analyzed: sukha duḥkha buddhyā śreyaḥ ntaḥ kartā yadā tadā iṣṭa viṣaye buddhiḥ sukha buddhiḥ aniṣṭa viṣaye buddhiḥ duḥkha buddhiḥ śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandhāḥ sukha duḥkha hetavaḥ puṇya pāpa karma anusārī bhūtvā prāpta śarīra saṃyogam aprāpta śarīra saṃyogam iva kurvāṇaḥ yadā dṛśyate tadā upahita jīvaḥ iti ucyate 60

original: mana ādiśca prāṇādiśca icchādiśca sattvādiśca puṇyādiśca ete pañcavargāṇāṃ dharmībhūtātmajñānādṛte na vinaśyatyātmasannidhau nityatvena pratīyamāna ātmopādhiryastalliṅgaśarīraṃ hṛdgranthirityucyate || 7 ||
analyzed: manaḥ ādiḥ ca prāṇa ādiḥ ca icchā ādiḥ ca sattva ādiḥ ca puṇya ādiḥ ca ete pañcavargāṇām dharmībhūta ātma jñānāt ṛte na vinaśyati ātma sannidhau nitya tvena pratīyamānaḥ ātma upādhiḥ yaḥ tat liṅgaśarīram hṛdgranthiḥ iti ucyate

original: tatra yatprakāśate caitanyaṃ sa kṣetrajña ityucyate || 8 ||
analyzed: tatra yat prakāśate caitanyam sa kṣetrajñaḥ iti ucyate

original: jñātṛjñānajñeyānāmāvirbhāvatirobhāvajñātā svayamāvirbhāvatirobhāvarahitaḥ svayaṃjyotiḥ sākṣītyucyate || 9 ||
analyzed: jñātṛ jñāna jñeyānām āvirbhāva tirobhāva jñātā svayam āvirbhāva tirobhāva rahitaḥ svayaṃjyotiḥ sākṣī iti ucyate 9

original: brahmādipipīlikāparyantaṃ sarvaprāṇibuddhiṣu avaśiṣṭataypalabhyamānaḥ sarvaprāṇibuddhistho yadā tadā kūṭastha ityucyate || 10 ||
analyzed: brahma ādi pipīlikā paryantam sarva prāṇi buddhiṣu sarva prāṇi buddhi sthaḥ yadā tadā kūṭasthaḥ iti ucyate 10

original: kūṭasathpahitabhedānāṃ svarūpalābhaheturbhūtvā maṇigaṇe sūtramiva sarvakṣetreṣvanusyūtatvena yadā kāśyate ātmā tadāntaryāmītyucyate || 11 ||
analyzed: svarūpa lābha hetuḥ bhūtvā maṇi gaṇe sūtram iva sarva kṣetreṣu anusyūta tvena yadā kāśyate ātmā tadā antaryāmī iti ucyate

original: satyaṃ jñānamanantamānandaṃ sarvopādhivinirmuktaṃ kaṭakamukuṭādyapādhirahitasuvarṇaghanavad vijñānacinmātrasvabhāvātmā yadā bhāsate tadā tvaṃ padārthaḥ pratyagātmetyucyate | satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahma | satyamavināśi | avināśi nāma deśakālavastunimitteṣu vinaśyatsu yanna vinaśyati tadavināśi |
analyzed: satyam jñānam anantam ānandam sarva upādhi vinirmuktam kaṭaka mukuṭa ādi apādhi rahita suvarṇa ghana vat vijñāna cit mātra svabhāva ātmā yadā bhāsate tadā tvam padārthaḥ pratyagātmā iti ucyate satyam jñānam anantam brahma satyam avināśi avināśi nāma deśa kāla vastu nimitteṣu vinaśyatsu yat na vinaśyati tat avināśi

original: jñānaṃ nāma utpattivināśarahitanairantaryaṃ caitanyaṃ jñānamityucyate | anantaṃ nāma mṛdvikāreṣu mṛdiva svarṇavikāreṣu svarṇamiva tantuvikāreṣu tanturiva avyaktādisṛṣṭiprapañceṣu pūrṇaṃ vyāpakaṃ caitanyam anantamityucyate | ānandaṃ nāma sukhacaitanyasvarūpo'parimitānandasamudro'vaśiṣṭasukhasvarūpaścānanda ityucyate || 12 ||
analyzed: jñānam nāma utpatti vināśa rahita nairantaryam caitanyam jñānam iti ucyate anantam nāma mṛd vikāreṣu mṛd iva svarṇa vikāreṣu svarṇam iva tantu vikāreṣu tantuḥ iva avyakta ādi sṛṣṭi prapañceṣu pūrṇam vyāpakam caitanyam anantam iti ucyate ānandam nāma sukha caitanya svarūpa uparimita ānanda samudra uvaśiṣṭa sukha svarūpaḥ ca ānandaḥ iti ucyate

original: etadvastucatuṣṭayaṃ yasya lakṣaṇaṃ deśakālavastunimitteṣvavyabhicārī tatpadārthaḥ paramātmetyucyate || 13 ||
analyzed: etat vastu catuṣṭayam yasya lakṣaṇam deśa kāla vastu nimitteṣu avyabhicārī tad padārthaḥ paramātmā iti ucyate 13

original: tvaṃ padārthādaupādhikāttatpadārthādaupādhikabhedādvilakṣaṇamākāśavatsūkṣmaṃ kevalaṃ sattāmātrasvabhāvaṃ paraṃ brahmetyucyate | 14 ||
analyzed: tvam padārthāt aupādhikāt tad padārthāt aupādhika bhedāt vilakṣaṇam ākāśa vat sūkṣmam kevalam sattā mātra svabhāvam param brahma iti ucyate 14

original: māyā nāma anādirantavatī pramāṇā'pramāṇasādhāraṇā na satī nāsatī na sadasatī svayamadhikā vikārarahitā nirūpyamāṇā satītaralakṣaṇaśūnyā sā māyā iti ucyate | ajñānaṃ tucchāpyasatī kālatraye'pi pāmarāṇāṃ vāstavī ca sattvabuddhirlaukikānāmiidamitthamityanirvacanīyā vaktuṃ na śakyate || 15 ||
analyzed: māyā nāma anādiḥ antavatī pramāṇa apramāṇa sādhāraṇā na satī na asatī na sat asatī svayam adhikā vikāra rahitā nirūpyamāṇā satī itara lakṣaṇa śūnyā sā māyā iti ucyate ajñānam tucchā api asatī kāla traye pi pāmarāṇām vāstavī ca sattva buddhiḥ laukikānām idam ittham iti anirvacanīyā vaktum na śakyate 15

original: nāhaṃ bhavāmyahaṃ devo nendriyāṇi daśaiva tu | na buddhirna manaḥ śaśvannāhaṅkāraḥ tathaiva ca || 16 ||
analyzed: na aham bhavāmi aham devaḥ na indriyāṇi daśa eva tu na buddhiḥ na manaḥ śaśvat na ahaṅkāraḥ tathā eva ca

original: aprāṇo hyamanāḥ śubhro buddhyādīnāṃ hi sarvadā | sākṣyahaṃ sarvadā nityaścinmātro'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: aprāṇaḥ hi amanāḥ śubhraḥ buddhi ādīnām hi sarvadā sākṣī aham sarvadā nityaḥ cit mātrā uham na saṃśayaḥ 17

original: nāhaṃ kartā naiva bhoktā prakṛteḥ sākṣirūpakaḥ | matsānnidhyātpravartante dehādyā ajaḍā iva || 18 ||
analyzed: na aham kartā na eva bhoktā prakṛteḥ sākṣi rūpakaḥ mad sānnidhyāt pravartante deha ādyāḥ ajaḍāḥ iva

original: sthāṇurnityaḥ sadānandaḥ śuddho jñānamayo'malaḥ | ātmāhaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ vibhuḥ sākṣī na saṃśayaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: sthāṇuḥ nityaḥ sat ānandaḥ śuddhaḥ jñāna mayaḥ malaḥ ātmā aham sarva bhūtānām vibhuḥ sākṣī na saṃśayaḥ 19

original: brahmaivāhaṃ sarvavedāntavedyaṃ nāhaṃ vedyaṃ vyomavātādirūpam | rūpaṃ nāhaṃ nāma nāhaṃ na karma brahmaivāhaṃ saccidānandarūpam || 20 ||
analyzed: brahma eva aham sarva vedānta vedyam na aham vedyam vyoma vāta ādi rūpam rūpam na aham nāma na aham na karma brahma eva aham saccidānanda rūpam

original: nāhaṃ deho janmamṛtyu kuto me nāhaṃ prāṇaḥ kṣutpipāse kuto me | nāhaṃ cetaḥ śokamohau kuto me nāhaṃ kartā bandhamokṣau kuto me ityupaniṣat || 21 ||
analyzed: na aham dehaḥ janma mṛtyu kutas me na aham prāṇaḥ kṣudh pipāse kutas me na aham cetaḥ śoka mohau kutas me na aham kartā bandha mokṣau kutas me iti upaniṣad 21
